blocked.name: Cursed Mirror
blocked.why: 'As this enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature until end of turn, except it has haste': copyOnEnter is permanent, mandatory and creature-only, with no duration or haste exception.

blocked.name: Living Death
blocked.why: No effect exiles only the creature cards from every graveyard and then puts the cards exiled this way onto the battlefield under their owners' control.

blocked.name: Disciple of Freyalise // Garden of Freyalise
blocked.why: 'You may sacrifice another creature. If you do, gain X life and draw X cards, where X is its power' needs a may-sacrifice whose tail reads the sacrificed creature; the sacrifice effect only queues its decision.

blocked.name: Chandra's Ignition
blocked.why: The targeted creature must be the source of the damage to each other creature and each opponent; damage-all/damage only deal damage from the resolving spell (or a trigger object).

blocked.name: Commander's Plate
blocked.why: Protection from each colour outside your commander's colour identity: protection colours are fixed in the card definition, not computed.

blocked.name: Plaza of Heroes
blocked.why: 'Add one mana of any color among legendary permanents you control' — add-mana has no 'colours among [filter]' form.

blocked.name: Field of the Dead
blocked.why: The intervening-if 'seven or more lands with different names' needs a condition counting distinct names among permanents.

blocked.name: Maskwood Nexus
blocked.why: 'Creatures you control are every creature type', including creature spells and cards in other zones — no every-type marker.

blocked.name: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar
blocked.why: Tokens 'tapped and attacking that player' for each opponent — no enter-attacking token creation.

blocked.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
blocked.why: Birgi's 'creatures you control can boast twice' has no vocabulary, and Harnfel's 'Discard a card:' activation cost isn't modelled.

blocked.name: Faeburrow Elder
blocked.why: 'For each color among permanents you control, add one mana of that color' — the P/T half is expressible (grantPtPerCount.colorsAmong), the mana ability isn't.

blocked.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
blocked.why: return-from-graveyard only reaches your own graveyard; nothing puts all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.

blocked.name: Mother of Runes
blocked.why: 'Gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn' — no effect grants protection, let alone a colour chosen on resolution.

blocked.name: Necropotence
blocked.why: 'Skip your draw step' has no vocabulary, and the pay-1-life ability exiles face down then returns that card to hand at the next end step.

blocked.name: Valakut Awakening // Valakut Stoneforge
blocked.why: 'Put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your library, then draw that many plus one': look-and-choose from hand only goes to the library top, and bottom order isn't chosen.

blocked.name: Wishclaw Talisman
blocked.why: 'An opponent gains control of this artifact' — no effect gives control to another (chosen) player.

blocked.name: Blasphemous Edict
blocked.why: 'You may pay {B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost if there are thirteen or more creatures' — alternativeCost has no condition and always taps creatures; freeCastIf is only free.

blocked.name: Gitaxian Probe
blocked.why: 'Look at target player's hand' — no effect reveals a hand to one player.

blocked.name: Veil of Summer
blocked.why: 'Spells you control can't be countered this turn', hexproof from blue and black, and 'if an opponent has cast a blue or black spell this turn' all lack vocabulary.

blocked.name: Voice of Victory
blocked.why: Mobilize 2 needs tokens created tapped and attacking.

blocked.name: Bolt Bend
blocked.why: 'Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target' — no retargeting effect.

blocked.name: Dread Return
blocked.why: 'Flashback—Sacrifice three creatures': flashback costs are mana (+ life) only.

blocked.name: Emergence Zone
blocked.why: 'You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash' — castAsThoughFlash is a static, with no one-shot this-turn form.

blocked.name: Sword of Feast and Famine
blocked.why: 'Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, … you untap all lands you control' is the Equipment's own trigger (its controller's 'you'); a granted trigger would belong to the creature's controller.

blocked.name: Mindbreak Trap
blocked.why: 'Exile any number of target spells', and the {0} alternative cost gated on an opponent having cast three or more spells this turn.

blocked.name: Maze of Ith
blocked.why: 'Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn' — prevent-damage only shields damage dealt to a target, by amount.

blocked.name: Conduit of Worlds
blocked.why: 'If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn' is a cast during resolution plus a conditional prohibition.

blocked.name: Laboratory Maniac
blocked.why: 'If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead' — no win-the-game replacement.

blocked.name: Unbreakable Formation
blocked.why: Addendum needs 'this spell was cast during your main phase'; a resolution-time main-phase check would wrongly give a copy the bonus (ruling).

blocked.name: Nesting Grounds
blocked.why: 'Move a counter from target permanent you control onto a second target permanent'.

blocked.name: Second Harvest
blocked.why: 'For each token you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent' — create-token-copy copies one named object.

blocked.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
blocked.why: 'Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order' — look-and-choose only puts the rest on the bottom in a random order. Everything else (including the transform and Itlimoc) is expressible.

blocked.name: Champion of Lambholt
blocked.why: 'Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block creatures you control' — a static's cantBeBlockedBy filter can't compare against the source's live power (an { amount } operand fails closed there).

blocked.name: Redirect Lightning
blocked.why: 'Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target' — no retargeting effect (the pay-5-life-or-{2} additional cost is expressible).

blocked.name: Opposition Agent
blocked.why: Controlling opponents while they search and exiling what they find for you to play — no search hooks.

blocked.name: Talon Gates of Madara
blocked.why: 'Up to one target creature phases out' — phasing isn't modelled; the {4} put-from-hand ability is also unusual.

blocked.name: Clever Concealment
blocked.why: 'Any number of target nonland permanents you control phase out' — phasing and unbounded targeting.

blocked.name: Thespian's Stage
blocked.why: 'This land becomes a copy of target land, except it has this ability' — no become-a-copy effect with an exception.

blocked.name: Six
blocked.why: 'During your turn, nonland permanent cards in your graveyard have retrace' — retrace isn't modelled (the attack mill/return is).

blocked.name: Culling Ritual
blocked.why: 'Add {B} or {G} for each permanent destroyed this way' from a resolving spell: mana added outside cost payment takes the first colour, with no player choice of split.

blocked.name: Darksteel Mutation
blocked.why: 'Is an Insect artifact creature … and loses all other abilities, card types, and creature types' — a static that sets (not adds) types and removes abilities from the enchanted creature.

blocked.name: Curiosity
blocked.why: 'Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw' is the Aura's trigger (its controller's 'you' and 'opponent'); the Aura can enchant an opponent's creature, where a granted trigger would be wrong.

blocked.name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
blocked.why: 'If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two instead' — would-draw has no first-in-draw-step exemption.

blocked.name: Return the Favor
blocked.why: Spree modes with additional costs, copying an activated/triggered ability, and changing a target.

blocked.name: Tibalt's Trickery
blocked.why: Random choice of 1-3, mill, exile-until a nonland card with a different name, and 'they may cast that card without paying its mana cost'.

blocked.name: Mulldrifter
blocked.why: Evoke.

blocked.name: Strionic Resonator
blocked.why: 'Copy target triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.'

blocked.name: Realmwalker
blocked.why: Changeling, look at the top card any time, and cast creature spells of the chosen type from the top of your library.

blocked.name: Deathrite Shaman
blocked.why: Its first ability targets, so it's not a mana ability; resolving from the stack, 'add one mana of any color' always makes {W} — manaColors is only honoured for a real mana ability. Verified in a test.

blocked.name: Hydroelectric Specimen // Hydroelectric Laboratory
blocked.why: 'You may change the target of target instant or sorcery spell with a single target to this creature'.

blocked.name: Cloud Key
blocked.why: chooseOnEnter only fires when the permanent is cast; a Cloud Key flickered, copied or reanimated has no type chosen and reduces nothing.

blocked.name: Bitterblossom
blocked.why: Bitterblossom is a Kindred Enchantment — Faerie; the engine has no Kindred card type, so card-type counts (delirium, Tarmogoyf) would be wrong.

blocked.name: Torment of Hailfire
blocked.why: 'Repeat the following process X times' — each iteration is an each-player-may punisher, but nothing repeats an effect X times.

blocked.name: Archdruid's Charm
blocked.why: Mode 1: 'Search for a creature or land card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card. Otherwise, put it into your hand' — search-library has one destination.

blocked.name: Dig Through Time
blocked.why: Delve, and 'the rest on the bottom of your library in any order'.

blocked.name: Hexing Squelcher
blocked.why: 'Spells you control can't be countered' — cantBeCountered is per card; no static grants it to your spells.

blocked.name: Trouble in Pairs
blocked.why: 'If an opponent would begin an extra turn, that player skips that turn instead' — no extra-turn replacement (the draw triggers are expressible).

blocked.name: Banner of Kinship
blocked.why: Enters with a fellowship counter per creature of the chosen type, and chosen-type creatures get +1/+1 per counter on the Banner — enters-with counters are fixed and grantPtPerCount can't count the source's counters.

blocked.name: Ancient Copper Dragon
blocked.why: Roll a d20.

blocked.name: Caretaker's Talent
blocked.why: Class levels aren't modelled.

blocked.name: Wizard Class
blocked.why: Class levels aren't modelled.

blocked.name: Treasure Cruise
blocked.why: Delve.

blocked.name: Plaguecrafter
blocked.why: 'Each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker. Each player who can't discards a card' — no per-player fallback on an edict.

blocked.name: Midnight Clock
blocked.why: 'When the twelfth hour counter is put on this' and 'shuffle your hand and graveyard into your library'.

blocked.name: Ozolith, the Shattered Spire
blocked.why: 'That many plus one +1/+1 counters' — would-add-counter only multiplies.

blocked.name: Sanctum Weaver
blocked.why: 'Add X mana of any one color' is paid as independently coloured units.

blocked.name: Incubation Druid
blocked.why: 'One mana of any type that a land you control could produce' (and three with a +1/+1 counter) — only the opponents'-lands form exists.

blocked.name: Borne Upon a Wind
blocked.why: 'You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash'.

blocked.name: Trailblazer's Boots
blocked.why: Nonbasic landwalk isn't a keyword.

blocked.name: Harmonic Prodigy
blocked.why: 'A Shaman or another Wizard you control' — doubleTriggersOf has no 'other than this permanent' clause, and a name filter would wrongly skip a second Prodigy.

blocked.name: Windbrisk Heights
blocked.why: Hideaway.

blocked.name: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn
blocked.why: 'You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game' — noMaxHandSize is only read off permanents, and emblems carry only anthems.

blocked.name: Sculpting Steel
blocked.why: 'Enter as a copy of any artifact' — copyOnEnter only copies creatures.

blocked.name: Imp's Mischief
blocked.why: 'Change the target of target spell with a single target'.

blocked.name: Dualcaster Mage
blocked.why: 'Copy target instant or sorcery spell. You may choose new targets for the copy' — copy-spell keeps the original's targets.

blocked.name: Sphere of Safety
blocked.why: 'Can't attack you … unless their controller pays {X} for each' — no attack cost.

blocked.name: Opal Palace
blocked.why: 'Enters with additional +1/+1 counters equal to the number of times it's been cast from the command zone' when this mana is spent on your commander.

blocked.name: Changeling Outcast
blocked.why: Changeling.

blocked.name: Gravecrawler
blocked.why: 'You may cast this card from your graveyard as long as you control a Zombie' — castFromGraveyard is a battlefield permanent's permission, not a card's own from its graveyard.

blocked.name: Shared Animosity
blocked.why: '+1/+0 for each other attacking creature that shares a creature type with it'.

blocked.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
blocked.why: 'As long as your devotion to red is less than five, Purphoros isn't a creature'.

blocked.name: Reflections of Littjara
blocked.why: 'Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen type, copy that spell' — copying the triggering spell, and permanent spells.

blocked.name: Innkeeper's Talent
blocked.why: Class levels aren't modelled.

blocked.name: Archivist of Oghma
blocked.why: 'Whenever an opponent searches their library'.

blocked.name: Muddle the Mixture
blocked.why: Transmute.

blocked.name: Into the Flood Maw
blocked.why: Gift a tapped Fish.

newFeatures.new:copy-on-enter-duration: An optional 'as this enters, you may have it become a copy of X until end of turn' with a duration, rather than a permanent Clone copy.
newFeatures.new:mass-graveyard-to-battlefield: Put every card matching a filter from all graveyards (or those an effect exiled this way) onto the battlefield, under their owners' or the effect controller's control; plus exiling only the matching cards from every graveyard.
newFeatures.new:damage-from-target: Damage (to one target, to each matching permanent, or to a player scope) dealt by a targeted permanent rather than by the resolving spell.
newFeatures.new:protection-choice-and-dynamic: Protection whose qualities aren't printed: 'protection from the color of your choice until end of turn' (chosen on resolution, as a one-shot grant), and 'from each color not in your commander's color identity' (computed).
newFeatures.new:add-mana-colors-among: add-mana reading colours off permanents: 'one mana of any color among [filter] you control', and 'for each color among permanents you control, add one mana of that color'.
newFeatures.new:distinct-names-count-condition: A condition/amount counting permanents with different names ('seven or more lands with different names').
newFeatures.new:boast-extra-activations: A static letting boast abilities be activated more than once per turn ('can boast twice during each of your turns').
newFeatures.new:skip-step: 'Skip your draw step' (and similar step skips) as a static.
newFeatures.new:hand-to-library-bottom-any-number: Put any number of cards from hand on the bottom of the library, and read how many were put ('draw that many plus one').
newFeatures.new:conditional-alternative-cost: An alternative mana cost gated on a condition ('pay {B} rather than this spell's mana cost if there are thirteen or more creatures'; a Trap's '{0} if an opponent cast three or more spells this turn').
newFeatures.new:spells-cant-be-countered-static: 'Spells you control can't be countered' as a static (or 'this turn' as an effect).
newFeatures.new:hexproof-from-colors: Hexproof from a colour for players and permanents.
newFeatures.new:change-target: 'Change the target of target spell or ability with a single target' (optionally to a specific object), re-checking legality.
newFeatures.new:flashback-nonmana-costs: Flashback costs with non-mana parts (sacrifice N creatures, discard, exile).
newFeatures.new:flash-permission-this-turn: A one-shot 'you may cast spells this turn as though they had flash' for the effect's controller.
newFeatures.new:trigger-on-attached-permanent: An Aura's or Equipment's own triggered ability watching the enchanted/equipped permanent ('whenever enchanted creature deals damage…', 'whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player…'), controlled by the attachment's controller.
newFeatures.new:prevent-damage-by-and-to-permanent: Prevent all (combat) damage dealt to and dealt by a target permanent this turn.
newFeatures.new:win-the-game: A 'you win the game' outcome, including as a replacement for drawing from an empty library.
newFeatures.new:addendum: Addendum: a spell condition true only if the spell was actually cast during its controller's main phase (a copy wasn't cast).
newFeatures.new:token-copy-for-each-matching: Create one token copy of each permanent matching a filter ('for each token you control, create a token that's a copy of it').
newFeatures.new:search-library-control: Hooks on library searches: control an opponent while they search, and redirect what they find to exile for you to play.
newFeatures.new:phasing: Phasing (rule 702.26): phase out/in, treated as though it doesn't exist until its controller's next untap step.
newFeatures.new:retrace-grant: Retrace (cast from graveyard by discarding a land in addition), including as a grant to graveyard cards.
newFeatures.new:set-types-static: A static that sets an affected permanent's card types and creature types and removes its abilities (Darksteel Mutation), rather than only adding.
newFeatures.new:kindred-card-type: The Kindred card type (formerly tribal), so a noncreature card with creature types counts it among its card types.
newFeatures.new:repeat-x-times: Repeat an effect block X times.
newFeatures.new:search-destination-by-type: A tutor whose destination depends on the found card's type ('onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card, otherwise into your hand').
newFeatures.new:skip-extra-turns: A replacement making an opponent skip an extra turn they would begin.
newFeatures.new:enters-with-counters-dynamic: An enters-with-counters self-replacement whose amount is a live count (e.g. of creatures of the chosen type).
newFeatures.new:anthem-per-counter-on-source: A P/T bonus to affected permanents that scales with counters on the static's source.
newFeatures.new:class-enchantments: Class enchantments: levels gained as a sorcery-speed activated ability, with abilities that switch on per level and 'when this Class becomes level N' triggers.
newFeatures.new:edict-fallback-per-player: An edict with a per-player fallback for each player who couldn't sacrifice ('each player who can't discards a card').
newFeatures.new:nth-counter-trigger: 'When the Nth [kind] counter is put on this' — a counters-put trigger keyed to crossing a count.
newFeatures.new:shuffle-zones-into-library: Shuffle a player's hand and/or graveyard into their library.
newFeatures.new:counter-replacement-additive: A would-add-counter replacement adding N more ('that many plus one') rather than multiplying.
newFeatures.new:add-mana-lands-could-produce: add-mana of 'any type that a land you control could produce'.
newFeatures.new:hideaway: Hideaway N and 'play the exiled card without paying its mana cost' gates.
newFeatures.new:no-max-hand-size-rest-of-game: 'You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game' from a resolving spell (a player-level, game-long effect).
newFeatures.new:attack-tax: Attack costs ('can't attack you unless their controller pays {X} for each').
newFeatures.new:commander-cast-count-amount: An EffectAmount reading how many times a commander has been cast from the command zone, applied to the spell the mana paid for.
newFeatures.new:cast-self-from-graveyard: A card's own static permission to cast itself from its owner's graveyard, gated on a condition ('as long as you control a Zombie').
newFeatures.new:count-sharing-creature-type: A count of other permanents that share a creature type with a given creature.
newFeatures.new:searches-library-trigger: A 'whenever a player searches their library' trigger.
newFeatures.new:transmute: Transmute: discard from hand as a sorcery to tutor a card with the same mana value.
newFeatures.new:gift: Gift: an optional promise to an opponent as the spell is cast, with 'if the gift was promised' riders.
newFeatures.new:draw-replacement-except-first: A would-draw replacement that exempts the first card drawn in each of your draw steps.
newFeatures.new:dynamic-compare-in-static-filters: Dynamic numeric operands (the source's power, a live amount) in the CardFilters statics read — cantBeBlockedBy, canBlockOnly, affects scopes.
newFeatures.new:spree: Spree: choose one or more modes, each with its own additional cost.

bugs.what: src/cards/pool.test.ts 'isDeckableCard excludes tokens and back faces' allows at most 20 non-deckable pool entries (POOL_CARDS.length - 20); this batch's three MDFC back faces (Boggart Bog, Mystic Peak, Tanglespan Bridgeworks) take it to 22. The margin needs raising or counting back faces explicitly; test files outside the batch's own are off-limits here.
